purpose: Compile one inspect-only DomainSpec v2 system graph for CyberAlchemy Workspace while preserving release admission and implementation acceptance as separate owner decisions.
semantic_limits: The compiled graph projects the Workspace capability ontology and never becomes definition, product, Project, or ontology authority.
Only inspect-only behavior is admitted; no semantic mutation, lifecycle promotion, persistence write, or network effect is modeled.
Essays remains a separately owned Project entry rather than a Workspace-owned subsystem.
The compiled graph is development evidence and grants no DomainSpec release admission or implementation authority.
